title: Normalized restriction/direct-image comparison and the ordinary integral scalar adjunction
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, a scheme morphism f:X to Y, tower geometry b,g [def-sp-tower-shriek-data], Chern data cY,cX [def-sp-tower-class-chern], and integral inverse-image data d [def-sp-tower-chern-pullback-intermediate]. Write resT for restriction along coefficientSystemMap [def-sp-tower-class-coefficients], UT for the recorded integral Forget functor [def-sp-tower-class-systems], and f_*^Ab for componentwise abelian direct image. There is a natural isomorphism chi:(g.push resY) UY -> (resX UX) f_*^Ab whose section maps are heterogeneous identity maps at every level and chart. There is an ordinary adjunction a:(d.pull EX) left adjoint to (g.push resY), with the following normalization for every integral module system M, coefficient module system N, and t:EX(d.pull M)->N: UY(a.adjoint(t)) followed by chi_N equals the componentwise abelian adjunct of d.forgetIso_M followed by UX of the ordinary scalar adjunct of t. No coefficient-unit map, root comparison, Kummer middle normalization, or derived map occurs in this assertion.

proof.text: The ordinary pushforward evaluation and the section, restriction, transition and morphism equations of the recorded Forget functors identify the forgotten restricted direct image with componentwise abelian direct image. Identity transport on every section gives chi, natural in modules and in the whole tower, with its stated section normalization.

proof.text: An additive morphism between integral quotient-module sheaves is linear over the constant residue-ring sheaf: locally lift a scalar to a constant integer, use preservation of integer multiples, and apply separatedness. Apply this at every level; tower naturality is unchanged. Hence each recorded integral Forget functor is fully faithful.

proof.text: Compose the target scalar Hom equivalence, the fully faithful target Forget Hom equivalence, precomposition with d.forgetIso, the componentwise abelian Hom equivalence and postcomposition with chi inverse, and finally the inverse of the fully faithful source Forget Hom equivalence. These are natural bijections in both variables and give a. Their defining formula is the asserted normalization.

theorem restrictedScalarAdjunction_exists
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E) (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f)
    (cY : Chern l E Y) (cX : Chern l E X)
    (d : IntegralCoefficientPullback l E f cY cX) :
    ∃ χ : (g.push ⋙ SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (coefficientSystemMap l E Y)) ⋙ cY.reduction.forget.F ≅
      (SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (coefficientSystemMap l E X) ⋙ cX.reduction.forget.F) ⋙ abPush f,
      (∀ (N : Systems X (Arings l E X)) (n : ℕ) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : (((cY.reduction.forget.F.obj
          ((SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
            (coefficientSystemMap l E Y)).obj (g.push.obj N))).obj (op n)).obj.obj U)),
        HEq ((((χ.hom.app N).app (op n)).hom.app U) x) x) ∧
      ∃ a : (d.pull ⋙ cX.scalar.model.E) ⊣
          (g.push ⋙ SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
            (coefficientSystemMap l E Y)),
        ∀ (M : Systems Y (Rrings l Y)) (N : Systems X (Arings l E X))
          (t : cX.scalar.model.E.obj (d.pull.obj M) ⟶ N),
          cY.reduction.forget.F.map ((a.homEquiv M N) t) ≫ χ.hom.app N =
            ((abAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _)
              (d.forgetIso.hom.app M ≫ cX.reduction.forget.F.map
                ((cX.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.homEquiv _ _) t))
